items.name: Rooftop Map
items.layout: Elevated rooftop arena with stairs, ramps, and open sightlines
items.updateContext: Replaced the launch Square Arena during the April 2026 map and zombie movement update
items.holdStyle: Hold stair and ramp chokepoints instead of spreading across open ground
items.laneNotes: Watch the entry ramps and stairwell approaches so zombie packs funnel into predictable fire lanes.
items.bestFor: Barricade and turret holds, piercing shots, area damage, and controlled retreats
items.performanceNote: Rooftop Map launched with public reports of lower FPS; lowering Roblox graphics is the practical workaround until optimization changes.
items.caveat: Exact in-game display name should be rechecked after the next map update; public sources use Rooftop Map or new map wording.
items.verificationNote: Roblox official page confirms the one-arena game premise. SurviveZombieArena.com identifies Rooftop Map as the active map at its 2026-05-18 check, and SZA Companion also treats Rooftop as the current public run context. No direct in-game check was performed in this phase.
items.imageStatus: local official Roblox thumbnail for current arena

items.name: Square Arena
items.updateContext: Launch-era arena replaced by Rooftop Map during the April 2026 map update
items.holdStyle: Open-field positioning with fewer natural chokepoints
items.laneNotes: Use it mainly to understand older guides that discuss flat placement, open movement, or pre-rooftop zombie pathing.
items.bestFor: Stale-guide context and comparing old open-field advice against the current Rooftop layout
items.performanceNote: No current performance note because Square Arena is not the active public layout.
items.caveat: Do not treat Square Arena as the current public map unless future in-game verification shows it returned in a selectable mode.
items.verificationNote: SurviveZombieArena.com and SZA Companion both describe Square Arena as the previous or replaced map. Current public availability was not directly verified in-game.
items.imageStatus: missing verified retired Square Arena image
